youtube.aciklama: At birth, the mastoid process has not yet developed; it usually becomes prominent in the first two years of life. So in infants, the point where the facial nerve leaves the bone is more superficial and more exposed to outside pressure. The bony part of the ear canal is also absent at birth, while the cochlea is already adult size.
